title: Volvo Taps Nvidia for Door to Door Driving by 2030
summary:
Volvo Cars will introduce a point-to-point autonomous system in its next-generation vehicles through an expanded partnership with Nvidia. The system will allow cars to navigate door to door across highways, busy city streets, and parking areas using Nvidia's Hyperion sensors and computer, Halos OS, and Alpamayo driving software.

The automaker aims to launch a Level 2++ hands-free driving system by 2030, gradually rolling out "eyes-off" and "mind-off" capabilities. The initiative combines Volvo's safety expertise with Nvidia's AI to move beyond current driver-assist features toward full automation in urban and rural environments.
